baselineDisplay.title: 即将到来的演唱会
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】即将到来的演唱会
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Why will the police have a difficult time?
问题：为什么警察的日子将不好过？
• 词汇准备
• group 小组，团体
• pop singer 流行歌手
• club 俱乐部
• performance 演出
• occasion 场合
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
The Greenwood Boys are a group of pop singers.
“格林伍德少年”是一个流行歌曲乐队。
At present, they are visiting all parts of the country. They will be arriving here tomorrow.
目前他们正在全国各地巡回演出，明天就要到达此地。
They will be coming by train and most of the young people in the town will be meeting them at the station.
他们将乘火车来，镇上的大部分青年人将到车站迎接他们。
Tomorrow evening they will be singing at the Workers’ Club.
明晚他们将在工人俱乐部演出。
The Greenwood Boys will be staying for five days. During this time, they will give five performances.
“格林伍德少年”准备在此逗留 5 天。在此期间，他们将举行 5 场演出。
As usual, the police will have a difficult time. They will be trying to keep order. It is always the same on these occasions.
同往常一样，警察的日子将不好过，他们将设法维持秩序。每逢这种场合，情况都是这样。
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1. Are the Greenwood Boys singers, or are they dancers?
2. When will they be coming here?
3. Who will be meeting them at the station?
4. How many performances will they give?
5. What will the police be trying to do as usual?
Answer: The Greenwood Boys are pop singers. They will be coming here tomorrow. Most of the young people in the town will be meeting them at the station. They will give five performances. The police will be trying to keep order as usual.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1. Most of the young people will be there. _____ the young people will be there.
(a) A lot
(b) Nearly all
(c) Some
(d) Many
2. How ______ staying? For five days.
(a) long they will be
(b) they will be
(c) long will they be
(d) long they be
3. During this time, they will give five performances. That's what they'll do ____ this time.
(a) in
(b) on
(c) for
(d) while
4. The police will have a difficult time ______.
(a) as usually
(b) as usual
(c) than usual
(d) from usual
5. The police ______ expecting the singers to arrive soon.
(a) is
(b) are
(c) will
(d) was
6. They are pop singers. So _______.
(a) they are folk singers
(b) they are public singers
(c) everyone likes them
(d) no one likes them
7. At present they are visiting all parts of the country. They are doing this ______.
(a) now
(b) for a short time
(c) in future
(d) all the time
8. They are visiting all parts of the country. So they will go ______.
(a) to cities, towns and villages
(b) only to towns
(c) only to villages
(d) only to cities
9. The Greenwood Boys will give five performances. They will give five _____.
(a) recitals
(b) executions
(c) plays
(d) songs
10. It's always the same on these occasions. It's always the same at _______ like this.
(a) situations
(b) conditions
(c) places
(d) times
Key: 1 b 2 c 3 a 4 b 5 b 6 c 7 a 8 a 9 a 10 d
第十单元 第二课
【语法点拨】表示目的、结果的状语从句
▶ so that
so that 的意思是“目的是……；结果……”,既可以引导目的状语从句，也可以引导结果状语从句。引导目的状语从句时，从句的谓语里常有 can, could, may, might, will, would 等情态动词。而引导结果状语从句时，则通常没有情态动词。
▪ The little boy saved every coin so that he could buy his mother present on Mother’s Day. (目的)
小男孩把，为的是能在母亲节给妈妈买一份礼物。
▪ The little boy saved every coin so that he bought his mother present on Mother’s day. (结果)
小男孩把，在母亲节那天给妈妈买了一份礼物。
▪ He always studies hard so that he may make great progress. (目的)
他总是努力地学习，这样他才会取得很大的进步。
▪ He always studied hard so that he made great progress. (结果)
他总是努力地学习，结果他取得了很大的进步。
▶ in order that
▪ in order that 的意思是“以便……,为了……”。 in order that 和 so that 表示目的时一样，从句的谓语动词里常有 can, could, may, might, will，would 等情态动词。
▪ She raised her voice in order that she might be heard.
= She raised her voice so that she might be heard.
她把音量抬高以便于别人听见。
➢ in order that 和 so that 与不定式 in order to, so as to 以及 to 表示目的时表达的意思一样，不过不定式表示目的时，句子是简单句。因此上一句还可表示为:
• She raised her voice so as to be heard.
• In order to be heard she raised her voice.
• She raised her voice in order to be heard.
• To be heard she raised her voice.
• She raised her voice to be heard.
▶ so...that 和 such...that
so…that 和 such…that 的意思都是“如此……以至”，二者皆可引导结果状语从句，且含义相同，但用法有一定的区别。
▪ 句型：so + 形容词/副词 + that
• He was so ill that we had to send for a doctor.
他病得很重，我们只好给他请医生了。
• The novel was so boring that he gave up reading it half way through.
这本小说非常乏味，他读了一半就不读了。
• She was so exhausted that she couldn’t move on.
她疲惫得无法继续前进。
▪ 句型：such + 形容词 + 不可数名词 + that
• This book is written in such easy English that beginners can understand it.
这本书是用非常简单的英语写的，初学者也能看懂。
▪ 句型：such + 形容词 + 可数名词复数 + that
• They are such difficult problems that I don’t know how to settle them.
这些问题是如此复杂，以至于我不知道如何解决。
▪ 要注意：当不可数名词前有 much, little 修饰时，要用 so, 不能用 such; 当可数名词前有 many, few 修饰时，要用 so, 不能用 such。
• He had so much work to do that he had to work late into the night.
他有那么多工作要做，不得不工作到深夜。
• There are so many kinds of bikes on sale at the market that I cannot make up my mind which to buy.
市场上出售的自行车种类很多，我拿不定主意要买哪一种。
第十单元第三课
【文化常识】Coffee Beverages 咖啡饮品
There are various types of notable beverages made from coffee. An affogato (Italian for ‘drowned’) is a coffee-based beverage or dessert. ‘Affogato style’, which refers to the act of topping a drink or dessert with espresso, may also incorporate caramel sauce or chocolate sauce.
有许多种知名饮料都是用咖啡制成的。阿芙佳朵(意大利语，意为“淹没”)是一种以咖啡为原料的饮品或甜点。“阿芙佳朵风味”是指将浓咖啡浇到饮料或甜点上层,其中也可能含有焦糖汁或巧克力酱。
A black eye is dripped coffee with a double shot of espresso. It has a strong taste. Caffe Americano or simply Americano is a style of coffee prepared by adding hot water to espresso giving a similar strength to but different flavor from regular drip coffee. The drink consists of single or double-shot of espresso combined with between 1 and 16 fluid ounces (30-470 ml) of hot water. The strength of an Americano varies with the number of shots of espresso added. A cafe au lait is traditionally the French way of preparing ‘coffee with milk’ both at home and in Cafes in Europe. Similar to the Portuguese Galao, a latte is a portion of espresso and steamed milk, generally in a 1:3 to 1:5 ratio of espresso to milk, with a little foam on top. Coffee milk is a drink similar to chocolate milk; however, instead of chocolate syrup, coffee syrup is used. It is the official state drink of Rhode Island in the United States. Cappuccino is a coffee-based drink prepared with espresso, hot milk, and steamed milk foam.
“黑眼圈”是一种注了双份浓咖啡的滴流咖啡,味道浓郁。美式咖啡(Caffe, 或简单称之为 Americano)是将热水倒入浓咖啡,与一般滴流咖啡浓度相似但风味不同。这种饮料含有一份或双份浓咖啡,配以 1-16 液盎司(30—470 毫升)的热水。美式咖啡的浓度随着加入的浓咖啡的份数而改变。法式咖啡即“咖啡加牛奶”,是传统的法式调制方式,常见于欧洲的家庭和咖啡馆。拿铁咖啡与葡式咖啡(Galao)相似,以 1:3 到 1:5 的比例分别加入浓咖啡和牛奶,饮料顶层漂浮一些泡沫。咖啡牛奶与巧克力牛奶类似,但其中加入的是咖啡糖浆而不是巧克力糖浆。咖啡牛奶是美国罗德岛州的官方饮品。卡布奇诺是一种加入了浓咖啡热牛奶和热奶泡的咖啡饮品。

注意：情态动词只是常见线索，不是目的和结果的唯一判据，还须结合语义。
▪ The little boy saved every coin so that he could buy his mother a present on Mother’s Day. (目的)
小男孩把每一枚硬币都攒起来，为的是能在母亲节给妈妈买一份礼物。
▪ The little boy saved every coin, so that he bought his mother a present on Mother’s Day. (结果)
小男孩把每一枚硬币都攒起来，结果在母亲节那天给妈妈买了一份礼物。
▪ He always studies hard so that he may make great progress. (目的)
他总是努力地学习，这样他才会取得很大的进步。
▪ He always studied hard so that he made great progress. (结果)
他总是努力地学习，结果他取得了很大的进步。
▶ in order that
▪ in order that 的意思是“以便……,为了……”。 in order that 和 so that 表示目的时一样，从句的谓语动词里常有 can, could, may, might, will，would 等情态动词。
▪ She raised her voice in order that she might be heard.
= She raised her voice so that she might be heard.
她把音量抬高以便于别人听见。
➢ in order that 和 so that 与不定式 in order to, so as to 以及 to 表示目的时表达的意思一样，不过不定式表示目的时，句子是简单句。因此上一句还可表示为:

• She raised her voice in order to be heard.
• To be heard she raised her voice.
• She raised her voice to be heard.
▶ so...that 和 such...that
so…that 和 such…that 的意思都是“如此……以至”，二者皆可引导结果状语从句，且含义相同，但用法有一定的区别。
▪ 句型：so + 形容词/副词 + that
• He was so ill that we had to send for a doctor.
他病得很重，我们只好给他请医生了。
• The novel was so boring that he gave up reading it half way through.
这本小说非常乏味，他读了一半就不读了。
• She was so exhausted that she couldn’t move on.
她疲惫得无法继续前进。
▪ 句型：such + 形容词 + 不可数名词 + that
• This book is written in such easy English that beginners can understand it.
这本书是用非常简单的英语写的，初学者也能看懂。
▪ 句型：such + 形容词 + 可数名词复数 + that
• They are such difficult problems that I don’t know how to settle them.
这些问题是如此复杂，以至于我不知道如何解决。

他有那么多工作要做，不得不工作到深夜。

市场上出售的自行车种类很多，我拿不定主意要买哪一种。
第十单元第三课
【文化常识】Coffee Beverages 咖啡饮品
There are various types of notable beverages made from coffee. An affogato (Italian for ‘drowned’) is a coffee-based beverage or dessert. ‘Affogato style’, which refers to the act of topping a drink or dessert with espresso, may also incorporate caramel sauce or chocolate sauce.
有许多种知名饮料都是用咖啡制成的。阿芙佳朵(意大利语，意为“淹没”)是一种以咖啡为原料的饮品或甜点。“阿芙佳朵风味”是指将浓咖啡浇到饮料或甜点上层,其中也可能含有焦糖汁或巧克力酱。
A black eye is drip coffee with a double shot of espresso. It has a strong taste. Caffè Americano or simply Americano is a style of coffee prepared by adding hot water to espresso giving a similar strength to but different flavor from regular drip coffee. The number of espresso shots and the amount of hot water vary with the recipe and serving size; both affect the strength of the drink. A cafe au lait is traditionally the French way of preparing ‘coffee with milk’ both at home and in cafés in Europe. Similar to the Portuguese Galao, a latte is a portion of espresso and steamed milk, generally in a 1:3 to 1:5 ratio of espresso to milk, with a little foam on top. Coffee milk is a drink similar to chocolate milk; however, instead of chocolate syrup, coffee syrup is used. It is the official state drink of Rhode Island in the United States. Cappuccino is a coffee-based drink prepared with espresso, hot milk, and steamed milk foam.

• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。

Question: Why will the police have a difficult time?
问题：为什么警察的日子将不好过？
• 词汇准备
• group 小组，团体
• pop singer 流行歌手
• club 俱乐部
• performance 演出
• occasion 场合

• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。

The Greenwood Boys are a group of pop singers.
“格林伍德少年”是一个流行歌曲乐队。

At present, they are visiting all parts of the country. They will be arriving here tomorrow.
目前他们正在全国各地巡回演出，明天就要到达此地。

They will be coming by train and most of the young people in the town will be meeting them at the station.
他们将乘火车来，镇上的大部分青年人将到车站迎接他们。

Tomorrow evening they will be singing at the Workers’ Club.
明晚他们将在工人俱乐部演出。

The Greenwood Boys will be staying for five days. During this time, they will give five performances.
“格林伍德少年”准备在此逗留 5 天。在此期间，他们将举行 5 场演出。

As usual, the police will have a difficult time. They will be trying to keep order. It is always the same on these occasions.
同往常一样，警察的日子将不好过，他们将设法维持秩序。每逢这种场合，情况都是这样。

• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1. Are the Greenwood Boys singers, or are they dancers?
2. When will they be coming here?
3. Who will be meeting them at the station?
4. How many performances will they give?
5. What will the police be trying to do as usual?

• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.

(a) A lot
(b) Nearly all
(c) Some
(d) Many

(a) long they will be
(b) they will be
(c) long will they be
(d) long they be

(a) in
(b) on
(c) for
(d) while

4. The police will have a difficult time ______.
(a) as usually
(b) as usual
(c) than usual
(d) from usual

5. The police ______ expecting the singers to arrive soon.
(a) is
(b) are
(c) will
(d) was

6. They are pop singers. So _______.
(a) they are folk singers
(b) they are public singers
(c) they sing pop music
(d) no one likes them

(a) now
(b) for a short time
(c) in future
(d) all the time

(a) to cities, towns and villages
(b) only to towns
(c) only to villages
(d) only to cities

(a) recitals
(b) executions
(c) plays
(d) songs

“黑眼圈”是一种注了双份浓咖啡的滴流咖啡,味道浓郁。美式咖啡(Caffè Americano, 或简单称之为 Americano)是将热水倒入浓咖啡,与一般滴流咖啡浓度相似但风味不同。浓咖啡份数及热水量因配方和杯型而异，二者都会影响美式咖啡的浓度。法式咖啡即“咖啡加牛奶”,是传统的法式调制方式,常见于欧洲的家庭和咖啡馆。拿铁咖啡与葡式咖啡(Galao)相似,以 1:3 到 1:5 的比例分别加入浓咖啡和牛奶,饮料顶层漂浮一些泡沫。咖啡牛奶与巧克力牛奶类似,但其中加入的是咖啡糖浆而不是巧克力糖浆。咖啡牛奶是美国罗德岛州的官方饮品。卡布奇诺是一种加入了浓咖啡、热牛奶和热奶泡的咖啡饮品。
